first C4 attempt failed at vLLM engine start (allocation error) because PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True (set globally at the Gemma restart) was inherited by the vLLM worker; C5 then deleted the judge before the pipeline was stopped. Fix: the setting now applies to training only; the judge had to be downloaded a SECOND time (2.2 min) and passed a 6-prompt smoke test (6/6 parsed) before grading

second C4 attempt failed its own disk pre-check (it required 26 GB free although the judge was already cached) and C5 deleted the judge again. Fixed: the headroom check applies only when the judge is not cached, and C5 deletes the judge only after C4 succeeded. Judge downloaded a THIRD time (2.2 min). The rule 'each big model downloaded at most once' was therefore not met for the judge
